description: THETIS is the information system of the European Maritime Safety Agency (EMSA) that supports port state control inspections under Directive 2009/16/EC. It gives inspection authorities in the Paris Memorandum of Understanding area (Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and the United Kingdom) an overview of ships for inspection. EMSA hosts and operates it; it stores and processes ship call information, calculates a Ship Risk Profile and inspection priority for each ship daily, organises the workflow from call to inspection, report and follow-up, and supports reporting, correction and publication of inspection reports. EMSA notes that about 14,000 port state control inspections take place in the EU each year. THETIS Med serves the Mediterranean MoU, and THETIS EU and THETIS MRV support other EU legislation. Coverage: ships calling at ports of the Paris MoU area. Access: operational use is for the relevant authorities; the overview page links to access and related portals. Licence and cost: no open licence is stated. Caveats: detailed records are not open data, and inspection data reflect targeting by risk, not a random sample of the fleet. It informs hazard exposure and resilience studies of port operations and substandard shipping. It relates to the THETIS MRV emissions data and the World Port Index in the catalogue.
